user.title: Connect to Anode
user.description:
**Link with your Anode account** to approve Home Assistant in the Anode web app, with no key to copy. It reaches only the hub you choose.

**Enter an API key** if you would rather create a key by hand, or if your account has no hub of its own. Create one in the Anode web app under Settings → API.

api_key.title: Enter an API key
api_key.description: Use the email for your Anode account and an API key created in the Anode web app under Settings → API.

data_description.email: The email address you sign in to the Anode web app with.
data_description.api_key: An API key created in the Anode web app.

link_expired.title: Link code expired
link_expired.description: The code ran out before it was approved.

hub.title: Choose a hub
hub.description: This account has no hub of its own, for example an installer account. Enter the ID of the hub to add. It is printed on the hub's label.

data_description.hub_id: The short friendly ID, for example ehxbt.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Anode
reauth_confirm.description: Anode no longer accepts the credentials for hub {hub_id}. Link again, or enter a new API key.

reconfigure.title: Change how Home Assistant connects
reconfigure.description: Choose how to connect to hub {hub_id}. Linking replaces the credentials with a key Anode issues for this hub; an API key is one you create by hand.

progress.wait_for_link:
Open the [Anode link page]({url}), check it shows code **{code}**, choose your hub and select **Allow**.

You will be asked to allow Home Assistant to see live readings and settings, and to change modes, schedules and power levels. This step finishes by itself once you approve. The code lasts 15 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anode cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Anode did not accept that email and API key.
error.hub_not_found: This account cannot access that hub. Check the hub ID.
error.hub_offline: The hub did not respond. Check that it is powered on and connected, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anode cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
abort.link_denied: Home Assistant was not allowed access in the Anode web app.
abort.link_rate_limited: Too many link codes were requested from this network. Try again in an hour, or enter an API key instead.
abort.wrong_hub: That link is for a different hub. Choose the hub this integration was set up for.
abort.link_insufficient: Anode did not give Home Assistant the access it asked for. Check the account is allowed to share the hub, then try again or enter an API key instead.
abort.link_failed: Linking was approved but Anode's answer could not be used, so the key it issued is gone. Try linking again, or enter an API key instead.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read from the Anode cloud. Every read is relayed to the hub over the internet.

auth_failed.message: Anode rejected the API key. Re-authenticate the integration to continue.

hub_offline.message: Hub {hub_id} did not respond. Check that it is powered on and connected.

hub_offline_command.message: The hub did not respond, so the change was not applied. Check that it is powered on and connected, then try again.

command_failed.message: The hub did not apply the change: {error}

invalid_soc_window.message: Minimum state of charge ({min_soc}%) cannot be higher than maximum ({max_soc}%).

soc_limits_unavailable.message: The hub did not report state-of-charge limits for battery {battery_id}, so they cannot be changed.

hub_not_found.message: {target} is not an Anode hub or one of its devices.

hub_not_loaded.message: Anode hub {hub_id} is not loaded. Check the integration in Settings → Devices & services.

read_only.message: Anode hub {hub_id} is linked with read-only access, so it cannot be controlled. Reconfigure the integration to link again, which asks for control as well.

not_permitted.message: Anode did not allow this key to make changes. Reconfigure the integration to link again, or use an API key with full access.

retired_entities.title: Anode override selects were replaced

set_override.description: Runs the hub in a mode for a set time, ignoring its schedule.

duration.description: How long to override the schedule for, in seconds. 0 ends any active override.

cancel_override.name: Cancel override
cancel_override.description: Ends any active override so the hub follows its schedule again.
